notes.title: New Content Update
notes.content:
With the release of [i]The Inner Friend[/i] on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, we also have added a new and unlockable cutscene in all three versions of the game!

To unlock the new cutscene, collect all 27 hidden objects throughout the game. Once you have all the objects, go to the bedroom, and take a look at the television.

Players who already have collected all objects are invited to simply go to the bedroom and interact with the TV!

Enjoy!

notes.title: PATCH 1.2 IS LIVE!

tags.feature: - Achievement related to collectibles that were collected prior to patch 1.1 can now be completed by entering the main menu;
- Completionist achievement can also be completed in the main menu;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug in The High School where you could see The Teacher's body before going into the the final room;
- Map loading issues in the Museum were fixed;

tags.feature: - Changed a few achievement names and icons.

tags.bug: - Other crashes, lags and bugs fixed.
